newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA TO EASE IMPORT RULES ON 83 FABRICS -REPORT.
newsitem.headline: INDIA TO EASE IMPORT RULES ON 83 FABRICS -REPORT.

text.p: India's Commerce Ministry will put 83 categories of fabrics on the open general list from January 1, 1998 as part of a plan to remove quantitative restrictions on imports, the Observer said on Tuesday.
India's open general list contains items which can be imported without prior government approval.
The fabrics were earlier in a special import licence category which groups items requiring government permission for imports.
The newspaper said the trade categories include cotton fabrics, coloured yarn fabrics, synthetic fabrics and woollen fabrics.
India has been facing pressure from Western nations to honour its commitments to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) and gradually remove quota controls on imports.
